+## TRAINING SEAM DRAFT against neutral c023, not applied by training lane.
+## Session alone calls this after actual sender/Altar/encounter/fallback guards.

+## cheaper debit, extra XP, replacement roster or a different portable carrier.
+func stage_creature_training(character_id: String, action: String, action_id: String,
+		expected_revision: int, intent: Dictionary, expected_before: Dictionary,
+		proposed_state: Dictionary, proposed_receipt: String) -> Dictionary:
+	if _portal_stages.has(character_id) or _loadout_pending.has(character_id) \
+			or _vitals_stages.has(character_id) or not _vitals_pending.get(character_id, {}).is_empty() \

+		return {"ok": false, "code": "stale_revision", "revision": revision(character_id)}
+	var current := state(character_id)
+	if current.is_empty() or not equivalent(current, expected_before):

+				intent, TRAINING.config(), PROGRESSION.config(),
+				Callable(TEACHING, "available_moves"), Callable(TEACHING, "character_loadout_mirror"))
+		"wild_defeat":
+			if intent.get("event_id") != action_id or intent.get("world_namespace") != _world_instance:

+			derived = TRAINING.stage_core_defeat(current, character_id, intent, expected_revision,
+				TRAINING.config(), PROGRESSION.config(),
+				Callable(TEACHING, "available_moves"), Callable(TEACHING, "character_loadout_mirror"))
+		_: return {"ok": false, "code": "unknown_training_action"}
+	if derived.get("ok") != true or derived.get("duplicate") != false \
+			or derived.get("receipt") != proposed_receipt or not equivalent(derived.get("state"), proposed_state):
+		return {"ok": false, "code": "training_derivation_conflict"}
+	var failures := errors(proposed_state, character_id)
+	if not failures.is_empty(): return {"ok": false, "code": "invalid_training_character", "errors": failures}
+	var before := _records[character_id].duplicate(true)
+	_training_stage_sequence += 1
+	var accepted := {"character_id": character_id, "action": action, "action_id": action_id,
+		"character_revision": expected_revision + 1, "intent": intent.duplicate(true),
+		"before": current, "state": proposed_state.duplicate(true), "receipt": proposed_receipt, "durable": false}
+	_records[character_id] = {"revision": expected_revision + 1, "state": proposed_state.duplicate(true)}
+	_training_stages[character_id] = {"token": _training_stage_sequence, "revision": expected_revision + 1,
+		"before_record": before, "accepted": accepted}
+	return {"ok": true, "duplicate": false, "token": _training_stage_sequence,
+		"character_id": character_id, "revision": expected_revision + 1,
+		"action": action, "action_id": action_id, "receipt": proposed_receipt}

+func staged_creature_training(stage: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var character: Variant = stage.get("character_id")
+	var frozen: Variant = _training_stages.get(character)
+	if not frozen is Dictionary or stage.get("token") != frozen.token \
+			or revision(character) != int(frozen.revision): return {}
+	return frozen.accepted.duplicate(true)
+
+
+func finish_creature_training(stage: Dictionary, world_saved: bool) -> bool:
+	var character: Variant = stage.get("character_id")
+	var frozen: Variant = _training_stages.get(character)
+	if not frozen is Dictionary or stage.get("token") != frozen.token \
+			or revision(character) != int(frozen.revision): return false
+	if not world_saved:
+		_records[character] = frozen.before_record.duplicate(true)
+	else:
+		_training_pending[character] = frozen.accepted.duplicate(true)
+		_training_pending[character].durable = true
+	_training_stages.erase(character)
+	return true
+
+
+func pending_creature_training(character_id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	return _training_pending.get(character_id, {}).duplicate(true)
+

+## Transport binds the actual sender before this exact ACK door. It never
+## receives/imports an owner snapshot, resource balance or new receipt.
+func acknowledge_creature_training(character_id: String, action: String,
+		action_id: String, character_revision: int, receipt: String) -> bool:
+	var pending: Variant = _training_pending.get(character_id)
+	if not pending is Dictionary or pending.get("durable") != true \
+			or pending.action != action or pending.action_id != action_id \
+			or pending.character_revision != character_revision or pending.receipt != receipt: return false
+	_training_pending.erase(character_id)
+	return true
+

+## Current world pending data alone may reconstruct a missing owner write.
+## Accepted history supplies revision high-water only: never overwrite a
+## newer portable owner earned in another world with old absolute snapshots.
+func recover_durable_training(character_id: String, deliveries: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	if _portal_stages.has(character_id) or _vitals_stages.has(character_id) or _training_stages.has(character_id):
+		return {"ok": false, "code": "transaction_busy"}
+	var candidate := state(character_id)
+	if candidate.is_empty(): return {"ok": false, "code": "not_admitted"}
+	var high_water := revision(character_id)
+	var id := TRAINING.training_delivery_id(_world_instance, character_id)
+	var raw: Variant = deliveries.get(id)
+	if raw == null: return {"ok": true, "state": candidate, "revision": high_water}
+	if not TRAINING.training_row_valid(raw, character_id, _world_instance) \
+			or not TRAINING.training_transition_valid(raw, TRAINING.config(), PROGRESSION.config(),
+				Callable(TEACHING, "available_moves"), Callable(TEACHING, "character_loadout_mirror")):
+		return {"ok": false, "code": "malformed_training_journal"}
+	high_water = maxi(high_water, int(raw.character_revision))
+	if raw.status == "accepted":
+		_records[character_id].revision = high_water
+		return {"ok": true, "state": candidate, "revision": high_water}
+	var owner := TRAINING.stage_training_owner(candidate, raw, TRAINING.config(), PROGRESSION.config(),
+		Callable(TEACHING, "available_moves"), Callable(TEACHING, "character_loadout_mirror"))
+	if owner.get("ok") != true: return {"ok": false, "code": "unsettled_training_conflict"}
+	var restored: Dictionary = owner.state
+	var failures := errors(restored, character_id)
+	if not failures.is_empty(): return {"ok": false, "code": "invalid_training_recovery", "errors": failures}
+	_records[character_id] = {"state": restored, "revision": high_water}
+	_training_pending[character_id] = {"character_id": character_id, "action": raw.action,
+		"action_id": raw.action_id, "character_revision": int(raw.character_revision), "intent": raw.intent.duplicate(true),
+		"before": raw.before.duplicate(true), "state": restored.duplicate(true), "receipt": raw.receipt, "durable": true}
+	return {"ok": true, "state": state(character_id), "revision": high_water, "pending_owner_save": true}

+func journal_creature_training_prepared(peer_id: int, character: String, accepted: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:

+	if not ledger.has_method("commit_creature_training_delivery"):

+func publish_creature_training(peer_id: int, character: String, receipt: String) -> bool:

+	if game == null or not bool(game.call("is_host")) or ledger == null \
+			or ledger.get("world") != game.get("world") or character.is_empty() \
+			or character != _registered_character(peer_id): return false
+	var world: RefCounted = game.get("world")
+	var session: Variant = game.get("session")
+	if not session is Node or not session.has_method("host_pending_creature_training"): return false
+	var id := TRAINING.training_delivery_id(str(world.get("reward_delivery_namespace")), character)
+	var pending: Variant = _training_publications.get(id)
+	var latest: Variant = world.get("reward_deliveries").get(id)
+	var frozen: Variant = session.call("host_pending_creature_training", peer_id)
+	if not pending is Dictionary or pending.peer != peer_id or not frozen is Dictionary \

+			or not TRAINING.training_row_valid(latest, character, str(world.get("reward_delivery_namespace"))) \
+			or latest.status != "pending" or latest.world_id != world.get("world_id") \
+			or latest.receipt != receipt or latest.character_revision != frozen.get("character_revision") \

+			and session.call("_settle_owner_training_accepted", game.get("local"), world, raw) == true
+	var result := TRAINING.apply_training_owner(game, raw,
+		Callable(TRAINING_TEACHING, "available_moves"), Callable(TRAINING_TEACHING, "character_loadout_mirror"))
+	if result.get("ok") != true or result.get("saved") != true: return false
+	if bool(game.call("is_host")):
+		return _accept_creature_training(raw.delivery_id, int(raw.journal_revision), raw.receipt, _local_peer_id())
+	if _can_rpc():
+		rpc_id(HOST_PEER_ID, "_rpc_creature_training_ack", raw.delivery_id, int(raw.journal_revision), raw.receipt)
+	return false

+@rpc("any_peer", "call_remote", "reliable", CHANNEL_LEDGER)
+func _rpc_creature_training_ack(id: String, revision: int, receipt: String) -> void:
+	var game := _game()
+	if game != null and bool(game.call("is_host")):
+		_accept_creature_training(id, revision, receipt, multiplayer.get_remote_sender_id())
+
+
+func _accept_creature_training(id: String, revision: int, receipt: String, peer_id: int) -> bool:
+	var game := _game()
+	if game == null or not bool(game.call("is_host")) or ledger == null \
+			or ledger.get("world") != game.get("world"): return false
+	var character := _registered_character(peer_id)
+	if character.is_empty(): return false
+	var world: RefCounted = game.get("world")
+	var row: Variant = world.get("reward_deliveries").get(id)
+	var session: Variant = game.get("session")
+	if not session is Node or not session.has_method("host_ack_creature_training") \
+			or not TRAINING.training_row_valid(row, character, str(world.get("reward_delivery_namespace"))) \
+			or row.world_id != world.get("world_id") or row.journal_revision != revision or row.receipt != receipt:
+		return false
+	if row.status == "accepted":
+		# Retry the registry unlock after an interrupted prior accepted write.
+		# Session must treat an already-unlocked matching current decision as
+		# idempotent without importing a client snapshot or changing revision.
+		return session.call("host_ack_creature_training", peer_id, row.action, row.action_id,
+			int(row.character_revision), receipt) == true
+	var saver: Variant = game.get("save_system")
+	if not saver is RefCounted or not saver.has_method("save_world_prepared") \
+			or not saver.has_method("fallback_busy") or saver.call("fallback_busy") == true \
+			or not ledger.has_method("accept_creature_training_delivery"): return false
+	var before: Dictionary = world.call("save_data")
+	var before_revision := int(world.get("revision"))
+	var before_seq := int(ledger.get("seq"))
+	var verdict: Variant = ledger.call("accept_creature_training_delivery", id, character, revision, receipt, peer_id)
+	var expected: Dictionary = row.duplicate(true)
+	expected.status = "accepted"
+	if not verdict is Dictionary or verdict.get("ok") != true or not verdict.get("delta") is Dictionary \
+			or not TRAINING._equivalent(world.get("reward_deliveries").get(id), expected):
+		world.call("load_data", before)
+		world.set("revision", before_revision)
+		ledger.set("seq", before_seq)
+		return false
+	if saver.call("save_world_prepared", game, str(world.get("world_id"))) != true:
+		world.call("load_data", before)
+		world.set("revision", before_revision)
+		ledger.set("seq", before_seq)
+		return false
+	# Even if the in-memory unlock fails, disseminate the durable accepted
+	# row. A later retry/recovery unlocks; accepted world data is never undone.
+	publish_journaled_delta(verdict.delta)
+	return session.call("host_ack_creature_training", peer_id, row.action, row.action_id,
+		int(row.character_revision), receipt) == true
